reason: We do library storytime, parks, the zoo and church groups, and I almost never pay for kid activities. I'd still be chasing my kid around, so the coffee isn't really a perk for me.
objection: I'd still be chasing my kid so I won't actually get to sit and drink coffee, and I can get the same play for free elsewhere. Paying $59 a month on top of that doesn't make sense.
would_change_my_mind: A free or very cheap trial visit that proved my toddler plays on their own while I sit, or a free community morning I could try with no commitment.
